docs.summary: Static push/pop modal stack for Origami. Any [`IModal`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.IModal) can be pushed. Modals stack with progressively darker backdrops. Renders above Layer.Overlay + 1000. Built-in modal types: - [`DialogModal`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.DialogModal) for confirm/message/custom dialogs - [`CustomDrawModal`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.CustomDrawModal) for full-control modals (file dialogs, selectors) Convenience methods: [`Confirm`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.Modal~Confirm), [`Message`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.Modal~Message), [`Custom`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Build.BuildOperation.Custom).
Whether `modal` is still on the stack.
Push any modal onto the stack.
Pop a specific modal from the stack (regardless of position).
